# Code of conduct

We want this project to be a place where people can work on hard security problems without being treated badly.

## Our standard

- Be respectful and assume good faith. Disagree with ideas, not with people.
- Give specific, kind, actionable feedback; accept it the same way.
- No harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, or publishing other people's private information.
- Keep discussion on the technical subject.

## Scope

This applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other space the project runs.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, close threads, and block people who break these rules. To report a problem, email security@qodiqa.com (the only project mailbox for now) with "conduct" in the subject. Reports are handled in confidence.

This code of conduct is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1 (https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
